title: The Healer's Legacy - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Healer's Legacy trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Healer's Legacy phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable, and the one trophy people assume is three quests or one. It is three, and delivering a single flower is not enough.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete Flesh Lily, Apprentice Healer and A Healer's Mercy.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
